name: Claude-BugHunter
description: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 82 skills, 15 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.
one_liner: A pre-packaged 'brain transplant' for Claude Code that turns it into a bug-bounty hunter — it already knows attack patterns from hundreds of real hacking reports.
buyer: An independent bug-bounty hunter who wants to triage more programs per week without hiring a team.
business_use_cases: A solo bug-bounty hunter installs it to auto-scan a new HackerOne target and get a ranked attack surface in minutes instead of hours of manual recon.
A boutique pentest shop uses it as a force-multiplier so two consultants can cover the client load of five, raising their margin per engagement.
A security trainer builds a paid bootcamp around it, teaching juniors each vulnerability class using the bundle's curated report patterns as case studies.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a 'pro' tier with private CVE chains and Burp integration support for professional pentest firms.
Run paid cohort-based training that uses the skill bundle as the core teaching tool.

steal_this: Package a narrower, single-vulnerability-class version (e.g. just OAuth/SSO attacks) as a $19 one-time skill pack sold on a skills marketplace.
